overlap_demo.detail: o1 (resume_mode=overlap) SIGKILL -> INTERRUPTED -> resume -> 'overlap 重叠重跑' -> rerun.jsonl created, meta.resume_mode=overlap_rerun

classification.SUCCESS: RUN_END present OR reached target round
classification.INTERRUPTED: rc in {137,143} or rc<0 (signal -> external interruption, not batch error)

resume_semantics.native: command supports resume from flushed prefix (e.g. mock); verified
resume_semantics.overlap: real runner CANNOT resume from death (run_e2e always starts at genesis); fallback = overlap rerun into rerun.jsonl with same copy/switch/sha
resume_semantics.blocked_on: T276 (kernel-dev) to make real runner resume from flush prefix; acceptance = byte-identical to one-shot run
resume_semantics.honesty: flush only guarantees a replayable complete prefix, NOT resumability; last partial flush window must be rerun

cleanup_policy.tmp_copies: deleted after collect; measured ~175.6 MB/copy; 4 batches/night ~700 MB/night
cleanup_policy.side: tar to side.tar.gz + sha256 then delete dir (inode); per-batch keep_side marker opts out (evidence-grade)
cleanup_policy.monitor: collect records df -h / df -i before+after; preflight warns on low MemAvailable; watch df -i (was near 89%)

dirty_tree_guard.why: tree=copy uses git archive <sha> (committed only); tree=main runs live working tree (includes uncommitted) -> if frozen dirs dirty, A and B/C/D run different code
dirty_tree_guard.implemented: start prints frozen-dirty warning; capture_provenance.sh records source_git_dirty_count + frozen dirty file list per batch
dirty_tree_guard.action_required: ensure code/{engine,life,freeze,config,obs,contracts,orchestration} clean before start; else abort and report leader

unverified: N=20 single-batch peak RSS (cap --mem-max 8G, watch heartbeat)
